  1. Show HN: Type Fighter 2

    • Education
    • Games

    143 points · 70 comments · 18 Nov 2026, 11:11 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — Type Fighter II is an arcade-styled touch-typing game with player selection, settings, credits, and a leaderboard visible from its start screen.

    Discussion — Players found it fun but requested keyboard-layout support (including Turkish Q and AZERTY), clearer controls, and an arcade/practice mode. A long thread debated teaching sequence: home-row drills and arbitrary letter combinations versus early use of common, meaningful words for motivation. One comment reported an SSL-certificate problem.

  2. Show HN: The Last Complication, a Zachtronics-style watchmaking puzzle game

    • Games

    89 points · 21 comments · 15 Nov 2026, 22:48 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — The Last Complication is a watchmaking puzzle game with staged benches and gear-ratio challenges. The linked game presents a workshop-like progression around assembling clock mechanisms.

    Discussion — Players found the puzzle rewarding but some struggled with the initial mechanics and asked for clearer explanations of gear ratios, better feedback, and more use of screen space. The author’s HN note identified the game as a Fable 5.2 creation.

  3. Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui

    • Games

    173 points · 44 comments · 14 Nov 2026, 14:05 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — Terminactory is an Apache-2.0 Rust terminal idle factory game for macOS/Linux (and Windows through WSL). Players mine, process, research, and sell resources; it includes an in-game browser/lore system, compact and Nerd Font options, and messages from Claude Code or other agents through tfac msg. The author says implementation used major Claude assistance.

    Discussion — Responses compared it with Factorio and Dwarf Fortress, questioned whether terminal presentation is enough differentiation, and suggested Nerd Font icons and different industrial processes. The author highlighted agent telegrams, lore, and quality-of-life features, added a calmer UI preset after criticism, and said they would rewrite AI-generated lore themselves.
